title: Mum's Middle — EN/ES/FR (Wilma McIvor)
style: folk country acoustic guitar warm female vocal 96bpm brushed drums gentle storytelling English Spanish French language learning trilingual
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The middle child gets good at watching
You learn to read a room before you speak
Corey never rushed the conversation
Just waited till it mattered and said it clean

[Verse 2 — Español]
Encontró el océano a su propio tiempo [He found the ocean in his own sweet time]
No rugby como su hermano, eso nunca fue lo suyo [Not rugby like his brother, that was never his]
Pero dale aire salado y una mañana abierta [But give him salt air and an open morning]
Así es cuando veo a mi hijo del medio tranquilo [That's when I see my middle boy at ease]

[Chorus — English]
My middle one, the one who found his own
My middle one, the one who made a home
Not louder than the others, not behind
My middle one — you were exactly right

[Bridge — Français]
Il m'a appelé un jour depuis l'eau [He rang me once from somewhere near the water]
Il a dit — Maman, je crois que j'ai compris [He said — Mum, I think I've worked it out]
J'ai dit — mon amour, tu avais compris à sept ans [I said — love, you worked it out at seven]
Tu avais juste besoin de temps pour te permettre de croire [You just needed time to let yourself believe]

[Verse 3 — English]
He sends me music now and asks what I think
And I listen in the garden with my cup of tea

[Outro — EN/ES/FR]
The gardens still growing
El jardín sigue creciendo [The garden is still growing]
Le jardin pousse encore [The garden is still growing]
My middle one
